name: Access Bank
description: Reads balances and transaction history from Access Bank (Nigeria) internet banking. Read only: it never transfers, pays or changes anything.

network.purpose: Signs in to your Access Bank internet banking and reads your accounts' balances and transaction history

integrations.name: Access Bank
integrations.description: Enter your Access Bank internet-banking user ID and password to link your accounts. These are your internet-banking credentials. Securo uses them read-only, to fetch balances and transactions. The first sync only links; press Sync now or wait for the next run.

fields.label: Currencies to import, comma-separated (for example USD). Leave empty to import every account
